Field: v0.129.6 pin #6161 then deposit #6162; related #5953 Phase 7 / #5994 thin host .mjs

## In plain English

After a maintainer dogfood pin to a newly cut runtime, Phase 7 release:local-update fails closed because tip Cursor agent-hook deposit still points at the previous deft-hook-<sha8> while installed @deftai/directive-runtime expects the new outer hash. Repair already rewrote the working tree, but local .git/info/exclude has .cursor/, so a normal git add never stages the new tip-tracked shim and operators invent a second deposit PR. Prefer-A makes pin/closeout land (or refuse with one force-add deposit-prep) so tip Cursor deposit matches the installed runtime hash without a standing second-PR ritual.

## Draft remedy sketch

1. Shared deposit-prep helper: after writeAgentHookDeposit / repair against the installed runtime, force-add tip-required Cursor paths (.cursor/hooks.json + .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs) despite local exclude .cursor/, and fail closed with one remediation command when tip HEAD still mismatches the installed outer sha.
2. Dogfood pin recipe and Phase 7 precondition call that helper before claiming pin-ready / before release:local-update agent-scope verify, so pin co-travels the version-matched deposit (or prints the single prep step).
3. Regression: fixture with exclude .cursor/ + new shim shows normal add miss, force-add stages, and verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent green against tip bytes for the new hash.
4. Release skill / print_deposit_recovery names that force-add + pin co-travel remediation; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] when mechanism lands.

## Reject (draft)

- Treat "always open a manual deposit PR after every pin" as the durable design.
- Auto-commit deposit bytes inside release:local-update (#5953 forbid).
- npm i -g as the deposit fix (Phase 7 does not run global install).
- Delete all .cursor/ exclude without a tip-track force-add carve-out for files tip already tracks under .cursor/hooks/.

## file_scope (lean)

- packages/core/src/init-deposit/ (force-add / tip-required Cursor path helper + fixtures)
- Taskfile.yml release:local-update / print_deposit_recovery (single remediation)
- content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md Phase 7 / pin closeout pointers
- CHANGELOG.md

audit-targets: none

Verdict: Prefer-A is directionally right, but cannot bind as drafted. Separate preparation of the pin candidate from read-only validation of landed tip; define the committed-byte proof. No runtime tests run: verification was pin-read at 633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf, with issue comments limited to 6772599386.

Mechanism inventory:
- [agent-hooks.ts](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf/packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts): writeAgentHookDeposit computes the outer source/hash, merges enabled-host registrations, and writes the corresponding shim. It does not stage Git paths. Its changedPaths records host configuration paths even for shim writes; that list alone is not a complete staging manifest. inspectAgentHookDeposit reads filesystem configuration and checks registrations against the expected hash.
- [host-hook-outer.ts](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf/packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts): hostHookOuterSource / hostHookOuterSha8 / hostHookOuterRelPath already define bytes, digest, and exact managed path. Reuse these from the installed target runtime.
- [Taskfile.yml](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf/Taskfile.yml), release:local-update: validates primary checkout and occupancy, refuses dirty state, pulls ff-only, frozen-installs, checks pin/installed version, runs agent verification before upgrade, then rejects visible diffs and verifies all hooks. print_deposit_recovery already reports incomplete and asks for merged deposits, but omits the exact new Cursor shim and force-add preparation.
- [release skill Phase 7](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf/content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md#L390): already requires tip-pin-equals-released and deposit merged before upgrade. The missing part is preparation/association, not an absent Phase 7 gate.
- The pinned tree tracks .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs. .git/info/exclude is Git-local metadata, absent from the pinned tree; its .cursor/ entry is field evidence from the issue/Stop 1, not independently verified by this pin-read. Existing tracked paths remain trackable; a newly hashed filename needs explicit inclusion.

### F1 — blocks-the-design — Pin co-travel versus Phase 7 precondition
Draft limbs 1–2 combine a helper that repairs/force-adds with a refusal while HEAD mismatches, and call it before Phase 7 verification. Force-add changes the index, not HEAD. Before the existing dirty check it causes refusal; after that check it still cannot establish landed-tip evidence and the later status check rejects it. Applying HEAD equality to the pre-commit pin candidate also refuses the very state preparation must produce. Consequence: bind two explicit uses of one association check: prepare and validate the candidate index on the pin branch; validate committed HEAD without repair/staging in Phase 7. Land the prepared deposit with the pin. Keep occupancy protection before any write and avoid ambient-worktree targeting. This closes the P1/P3 sequence without auto-commit or a standing second PR.

### F2 — blocks-the-design — Committed-byte association, not local verifier green
inspectAgentHookDeposit (lines 1003–1130) reads working-tree registrations; it does not establish HEAD membership or compare the committed shim bytes with hostHookOuterSource. The Taskfile calls filesystem verification, and ordinary git status can omit an ignored new shim. Thus config naming the new hash plus a locally present ignored shim is not proof another checkout receives that shim. Consequence: require the chosen candidate/HEAD tree to contain the expected shim bytes and configuration association for the installed target version. Extend the exclude+new-shim fixture: repaired local bytes with omitted shim must fail the committed-tree check; staging alone must not satisfy the Phase 7 HEAD check; the committed pair must pass. Preserve existing hook verification for its separate registration/behavior coverage. This is the essential P4 bookend.

### F3 — sharpens-framing — Force-add tip-required Cursor paths
Do not interpret “files tip already tracks” as exact-path membership: the new hash is necessarily a new path. Derive the enabled Cursor configuration plus expected new shim from the installed runtime, force-add only that bounded set, and explicitly validate the resulting candidate. Broad directory force-add risks unrelated ignored files; filtering only existing tracked filenames reproduces P2. This sharpens the existing limb without requiring another subsystem.

Accept all draft Reject items and both issue Rejected items: no standing manual second PR, no auto-commit inside local-update, no global npm deposit fix, and no wholesale exclude removal. Strongest alternative is a clearer Phase 7 refusal alone; it preserves safety but leaves pin preparation and repeated recovery unresolved. It would suffice only if the claimed relief were narrowed accordingly.

Missing limb titles: (1) Force-add exact tip-required Cursor paths; (2) Pin-candidate preparation versus landed-tip Phase 7 precondition; (3) Exclude+new-shim fixture with candidate/HEAD negative cases; (4) Single remediation print pointing to the preparation step and normal pin landing. Naming/docs/alias polish is footnote scope. Keep the bound remedy to these short limbs.

## Verdict

Prefer-A draft 6772593569 can bind after sharpening the four missing one-line Bound-remedy limb titles. It correctly refutes the Stop 1 presumption (pin + Phase 7 may leave Cursor deposit behind the installed outer hash and rely on a standing second deposit PR). No `blocks-the-design` from pin-read at dispatch-sha `633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf`.

## Mechanism inventory (pin-read)

- `packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts`: `hostHookOuterSha8` / `hostHookOuterRelPath("cursor", sha8)` → `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`; tip at pin tracks `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs` + `.cursor/hooks.json` pointing at that outer.
- `packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts` `writeAgentHookDeposit`: writes host outer + merges Cursor registration against installed outer source; filesystem only — no `git add` / force-add / staging.
- `Taskfile.yml` `release:local-update`: after tip-pin-equals-released, `DEFT_DOCTOR_HOOK_DIAGNOSTIC=1 … verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent`; on miss calls `print_deposit_recovery` then exit 1. Recovery text: "merge the version-matched agent-hook deposit for $VERSION onto tip" + re-run local-update; explicitly "Do not auto-commit deposit bytes…; do not npm i -g."
- `content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md` Phase 7 step 8: same fail-closed deposit-already-on-tip bookend; deposit-merge recovery; anti-pattern forbids auto-commit inside release and `npm i -g`.
- Maintainer `.git/info/exclude` (common-dir): `.cursor/` (also `.grok/` / `.codex/`). `git check-ignore -v .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-DEADBEEF.mjs` → exclude hit; tip-tracked shim is not ignore-dropped. Ordinary `git add` therefore misses a newly written tip-required shim while repair already rewrote the working tree — field match for P2 / #6162.

## Findings

### F1 — sharpens-framing
Prefer-A sketch is four mechanism ideas without unique one-line Bound-remedy limb titles. Under #5783 / Thin Fail-Closed #3265, bind needs short limbs, not a multi-bullet essay. Missing titles to name before bind: (1) force-add tip-required Cursor paths; (2) pin co-travel vs Phase 7 precondition ownership; (3) fixture exclude+new shim; (4) single remediation print. Failure mode: Recut thrash / empty harvest digest on multi-sentence sketch. Disposition: remint Prefer-A with those four one-sentence limbs.

### F2 — sharpens-framing
Phase 7 already fail-closes on outer-hash drift (`verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` before upgrade). Prefer-A's novel value is deposit-prep force-add + rewriting `print_deposit_recovery` away from "merge a second deposit PR," not a second verify gate. Draft item 2 ("Phase 7 precondition call that helper before … agent-scope verify") can be misread as duplicating the existing bookend. Disposition: keep existing verify as the fail-closed association; frame helper as prep that makes verify green, and replace recovery prose with one force-add / pin co-travel command.

### F3 — sharpens-framing
Siting "shared deposit-prep helper" under `packages/core/src/init-deposit/` without stating the git-stage association. `writeAgentHookDeposit` today never stages. Force-add is an index op against local exclude. Failure mode: library that "force-adds" by writing files only (false relief for P2/P3), or a helper that commits (hits #5953 / Prefer-A Reject). Disposition: helper enumerates tip-required Cursor paths (`.cursor/hooks.json` + `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`); `git add -f` of those paths lives in pin/Phase 7 recipe or a thin stage-only helper that never commits.

### F4 — footnote
Prefer-A Reject list accepts issue `## Rejected` and correctly adds auto-commit-inside-`release:local-update` (already printed by `print_deposit_recovery` and release-skill anti-patterns). Keep that reject on bind; issue body Rejected is thinner than the draft.

### F5 — footnote
`.grok/` / `.codex/` share the exclude pattern. Cursor-at-minimum matches issue Expected; widen only with field evidence of the same miss.

## Accept / reject vs Prefer-A Reject + issue Rejected

Accept Prefer-A Reject in full:
- standing manual deposit PR after every pin as durable design
- auto-commit deposit bytes inside `release:local-update` (#5953)
- `npm i -g` as deposit fix
- delete-all `.cursor/` exclude without tip-track force-add carve-out

No Prefer-A Reject item to drop. No issue Rejected item that Prefer-A contradicts.

## Missing limb titles (if binding under-specified Prefer-A)

1. Force-add tip-required Cursor paths — `.cursor/hooks.json` + `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs` despite local exclude `.cursor/`.
2. Pin co-travel vs Phase 7 precondition — which bookend owns prep; existing `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` stays the fail-closed gate.
3. Fixture — local exclude `.cursor/` + new shim: normal add misses; force-add stages; `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` green against tip bytes for the new hash.
4. Single remediation print — replace `print_deposit_recovery` "merge the version-matched … deposit" with one force-add + pin co-travel command (no auto-commit, no `npm i -g`).

## Road-not-taken / steelman

Road-not-taken: delete `.cursor/` from `.git/info/exclude` so ordinary add works. Rejected by Prefer-A (and correctly): blanket un-exclude without tip-track carve-out widens noise under dogfood deposit dirs. Force-add of tip-required paths keeps exclude intent and closes P2.

Injection/swarm lens: N/A for authority/envelope; force-add carve-out must stay tip-required paths only (Prefer-A Reject already covers).

clean-result: no (material sharpenings F1–F3; no blocks-the-design)

verification-path: pin-read only — `git show 633ff476f3fdd9f302d81627daa6ddeea32f4baf:<path>` from dest `.deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-6163`, plus one throwaway temp-repo git experiment outside this repo. No repository writes.

## Verdict

Prefer-A **cannot bind as drafted**. Two blockers: the remedy is anchored to the wrong commit class (the drift is born at the host-source-change PR, not at the pin), and limb 1 as placed ("after writeAgentHookDeposit / repair … force-add") is self-defeating against Phase 7's own clean-tree invariants. P2 and P4 are real; P1 is misattributed; P3 is mostly already solved.

## Mechanism inventory (pin-read)

- `packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts:54` `hostHookOuterSha8(source = hostHookOuterSource())` — the sha8 is a **pure function of a string literal in framework source at that revision**. No install, no registry, no runtime needed to compute it.
- `host-hook-outer.ts:31` `hostHookOuterRelPath(host, sha8)` — already enumerates all four host deposit paths (`.grok/hooks/`, `.cursor/hooks/`, `.claude/`, `.codex/`). The tip-required path list already exists.
- `Taskfile.yml:947` `print_deposit_recovery` — already prints **one** remediation, already enumerates the managed paths (`:951`), already carries both forbids (no auto-commit, no `npm i -g`).
- `Taskfile.yml:1014` dirty-tree refuse; `:1050` `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` (pre-upgrade); `:1068` post-upgrade `git status --porcelain` non-empty ⇒ closeout incomplete.
- `Taskfile.yml:426` `check:merge` → `:432` `check:framework-source` is the per-PR merge chokepoint (`ci.yml` runs `task check:merge`). `verify:hooks-installed` occurs **nowhere** under `.github/` and nowhere in `check:framework-source` — only at `Taskfile.yml:1050/1074`, inside `release:local-update`. The one gate that catches this runs once per release, in a maintainer's local checkout.
- `verify:deposit-closure` (`:453`) is **not** this gate: `packages/core/src/verify-source/deposit-closure.ts` covers declared **content-pack** paths surviving prepack (#3601 C1), not root host-hook deposits. Do not mis-reuse it.
- Tip `.gitignore` contains **no** cursor entry. The `.cursor/` ignore is machine-local: `.git/info/exclude:66`.

## Findings

### F1 — Drift origin is #6126, not the pin · `blocks-the-design`

Evidence — `git show --name-status 0c6efa275` (#6126, "lock operator-disable eligibility across hosts"):

```
R071  .claude/deft-hook-9138a8b8.mjs      -> .claude/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs
M     .claude/settings.json
R071  .codex/deft-hook-9138a8b8.mjs       -> .codex/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs
M     .codex/hooks.json
R071  .grok/hooks/deft-hook-9138a8b8.mjs  -> .grok/hooks/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs
M     .grok/hooks/deft.json
```

Zero `.cursor/` entries. That same commit edited `host-hook-outer.ts` — the sha8 SoT. Tracked shims at the pin commit `2f1deac33`:

```
.claude/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs        .codex/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs
.grok/hooks/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs    .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-9138a8b8.mjs   <-- sole straggler
```

and `.claude/settings.json` at that commit already named `a598056e`. So **3 of 4 hosts co-travelled with the source change, two PRs before the pin.** The de facto convention is deposit-follows-tip-source, refreshed in the commit that moves `hostHookOuterSource()`.

Failure mode: limbs 1–2 install the bookend at pin / Phase 7, which is two PRs and one published release downstream of the defect. The window source-change → release → pin stays unguarded for every future edit to `host-hook-outer.ts`, and the next straggler is again discovered by a maintainer's local `release:local-update` after npm publish. Consequence: Prefer-A binds its remedy to the wrong commit class, buying detection at the most expensive moment while leaving the cheap one open.

### F2 — Force-add inside the deposit writer self-fails Phase 7 · `blocks-the-design`

`git add -f` stages, so `git status --porcelain` becomes non-empty. `release:local-update` invokes `directive upgrade` and then treats any porcelain output as closeout-incomplete at `Taskfile.yml:1068`. A helper wired "after writeAgentHookDeposit / repair" fires inside that upgrade and makes **every** Phase 7 run fail there. A repair run done beforehand hits the same wall at `:1014` dirty-tree refuse.

Injection / swarm lens (fires: shared state, concurrency, executed-hook authority). A framework tool that force-adds mutates the operator's index. Under #4066 swarm workers sharing a checkout it races a worker's own staging, and it is the near neighbour of the #5953 auto-commit forbid that the draft's own Reject list keeps. Consequence: limb 1 must be **print-only** — emit the exact tip-required paths and the one `git add -f` command; never execute the add.

### F3 — P2's stated mechanism is necessary-not-sufficient · `sharpens-framing`

Temp-repo experiment (`.git/info/exclude` = `.cursor/`; `hooks.json` + old shim already indexed; new shim + modified `hooks.json` on disk):

```
A) git add -A        -> exit 0, SILENT. staged: .cursor/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-9138a8b8.mjs
                        (the new untracked shim is dropped with no message)
B) git add .cursor/hooks/deft-hook-a598056e.mjs
                     -> exit 1: "The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files: .cursor"
                        "hint: Use -f if you really want to add them."
C) git add -f <same> -> exit 0, staged.
```

Two corrections this forces:

1. A **modified tracked** `.cursor/hooks.json` is staged normally by `git add -A` — tracked files are never ignored. At `2f1deac33` that file still read `9138a8b8`, so the exclude **cannot** explain it. The Cursor deposit was never written to the working tree in #6126, or the pair was backed out wholesale. The exclude is a contributing obstacle, not the sufficient cause.
2. Explicit-pathspec add does **not** fail silently — it exits 1 with the `-f` hint. The silent mode is specifically the bulk-add form. So the cheap remedy is an **explicit tip-required path list** (which `hostHookOuterRelPath` already produces); `-f` only suppresses a message that is already loud.

Also: the exclude is at `.git/info/exclude:66`, machine-local, with no tracked `.gitignore` counterpart. A limb phrased "despite local exclude `.cursor/`" remedies one maintainer's machine config. The durable limb is **four-host coverage parity**, not a Cursor special case.

### F4 — P3 is already solved; limb 4 is a string edit · `sharpens-framing`

`print_deposit_recovery` (`Taskfile.yml:947-952`) already prints exactly one remediation with the managed-path list and both forbids, and `:1050-1051` already fails closed to it. It works as designed. The only gaps: `:951` names `.cursor/hooks.json` but not the hash-bearing `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`, and there is no `-f` hint. Keep limb 4, but demote it from mechanism to a two-string edit.

### F5 — file_scope points at the wrong module for the path list · `footnote`

Draft file_scope names `packages/core/src/init-deposit/` for a new helper. `hostHookOuterRelPath` / `hostHookOuterSha8` (`host-hook-outer.ts:31,54`) are already that SoT. No second enumeration should be authored.

## Accept / reject

Accept all four of the draft's rejects and the issue's Rejected section unchanged — including "no auto-commit inside `release:local-update`" and "no `npm i -g`". Add one: **reject force-add executed by framework code**; print-only (F2).

## Missing limbs (Prefer-A is directionally right on P2 / P4)

1. **Tip-source deposit parity gate on the merge chokepoint.** For all four hosts, assert the tracked config command string and the tracked shim filename equal `hostHookOuterSha8(hostHookOuterSource())` at the same revision. Pure source: no install, no pin, deterministic. Add to `check:framework-source` (`Taskfile.yml:432`) so it runs per-PR via `check:merge`. Red on #6126-as-authored; green at every other commit in that window. This replaces limbs 1 + 2 + 3 and is thinner than all three.
2. **Four-host coverage parity, not a Cursor carve-out** — one list from `hostHookOuterRelPath`, no per-host branch.
3. **Print-only force-add remediation** — exact paths plus the single `git add -f` line, emitted by the deposit writer and by `print_deposit_recovery`. Never executed (F2).
4. **Pin co-travel stays a Phase 7 precondition footnote**, not a new helper. `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` at `:1050` already is that precondition and is correctly fail-closed.

## Road-not-taken

I chose the **tip-source** parity gate over an **installed-runtime** parity gate at pin time. Steelman for pin-time: only the installed-runtime comparison proves the operator's deposit matches what the pinned runtime would actually write, and it is already implemented as `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` — adding it to CI is a one-line dep. What flips my verdict: if the intended convention is deposit-matches-installed-runtime rather than deposit-matches-tip-source, then #6126 was wrong to refresh three hosts ahead of the pin and the whole remedy does belong at pin time. Evidence against that reading: #6126 refreshed 3/4 hosts in the source commit with CI green, and `.claude/settings.json` already named `a598056e` at the pin. A CI `verify:hooks-installed` would also go red across the entire source-change → pin window, which is the likely reason it is not there.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

After a maintainer dogfood pin to a newly cut runtime (field: **0.129.6** / pin PR #6161), Phase 7 `task release:local-update -- <version> --checkout <primary>` failed closed because tip Cursor agent-hook deposit still pointed at the **previous** shim hash (`deft-hook-9138a8b8`) while installed `@deftai/directive-runtime@0.129.6` expected **`deft-hook-a598056e`**.

Recovery required a **second** PR (#6162) that updated `.cursor/hooks.json` and force-added/renamed the Cursor shim. The new shim already existed on disk after `writeAgentHookDeposit` / repair, but `.git/info/exclude` ignored `.cursor/`, so a normal `git add` never staged it.

## Why this is wrong

Pin + Phase 7 are the documented closeout path after every release (#5953). Operators should not need a separate deposit PR every cut when the runtime deposit hash moves. Local exclude of `.cursor/` makes the mismatch easy to miss until `verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` fails under `DEFT_DOCTOR_HOOK_DIAGNOSTIC=1`.

## Expected

1. After dogfood pin (or as an explicit Phase 7 precondition), tip deposit for enabled hosts matches the **installed** runtime deposit hash (Cursor at minimum: `.cursor/hooks.json` + tracked shim).
2. Refreshed Cursor shim paths are force-addable / not silently dropped by local `.git/info/exclude` for files that tip already tracks under `.cursor/hooks/`.
3. `release:local-update` either passes without a follow-up deposit PR, or prints a single remediation that lands the deposit (skill/checklist or automated prep) before upgrade.

## Actual (0.129.6)

1. Pin #6161 merged: `package.json` / AgeExclude / lock → 0.129.6.
2. `pnpm install` → installed 0.129.6.
3. `release:local-update` failed: Cursor deposit drifted (`9138a8b8` vs `a598056e`).
4. Separate deposit PR #6162 required; then local-update COMPLETE.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Documented or automated path so pin/closeout lands version-matched Cursor agent-hook deposit with the pin (or fails with one clear deposit-prep step).
- [ ] New/changed `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-*.mjs` that tip must track are not lost to local exclude without an explicit force-add remediation in the closeout recipe.
- [ ] Re-run of Phase 7 after pin does not require inventing a second PR solely for Cursor hash drift when repair already rewrote the working tree.

## Field refs

- Release: v0.129.6 maintainer cut
- Pin: https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/6161
- Deposit: https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/6162
- Related: #5953 (Phase 7), #5954 (release skill gaps), #5994 (thin host .mjs)

## Rejected

- Treat "always open a manual deposit PR after every pin" as the durable design
- `npm i -g` as the deposit fix (Phase 7 explicitly does not run global install)
